channel.description: Provenance-aware feed; classification fields distinguish exact wire copies from citations.

item.title: House Epstein Panel Chair Threatens Leon Black with Contempt
item.description: The chairman of the House committee investigating Jeffrey Epstein threatened to hold Leon Black in contempt of Congress if he fails to appear before the panel next month or doesn’t produce nondisclosure agreements the panel has subpoenaed.
item.dc:creator: Caitlin Reilly and Laura Benitez

item.title: Bolsonaro Names Ex-Energy Minister as Campaign Economic Adviser
item.description: Brazilian presidential candidate Flavio Bolsonaro announced a slate of new economic advisers Tuesday, including an economist and former minister who has published proposals for reining in the country’s rising debt levels.
item.dc:creator: Daniel Carvalho

item.title: Global Bond Slump Raises Fed Questions | Bloomberg Businessweek Daily 8/18/2026
item.description: Long-term debt costs are soaring as the bond market slumps. Bloomberg's Chief US Interest Rate Strategist Ira Jersey and Corporate Finance Reporter Davide Barbuscia explain why this jump is happening and what it signals to the Fed. Then, Empower Chief Investment Strategist Marta Norton on this week's global bond slump and how it's changing investor positioning. Plus, China Beige Book COO Shehzad Qazi previews next month's meeting between China's Xi Jinping and President Trump, and the future of trade between the two countries. Finally, Root CEO Alex Timm discusses how his company uses AI to help determine behavior-based car insurance. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Zelenskyy’s Popular Ex-Minister Calls for Ukrainian Election
item.description: The popular former Ukrainian defense minister, whose firing by President Volodymyr Zelenskyy triggered nationwide protests, strongly hinted at his political ambitions with a late-night video calling for wartime elections.
item.dc:creator: Volodymyr Verbianyi

item.title: US Sanctions Top ICC Officials and Vows to ‘Dismantle’ Court
item.description: The Trump administration announced sanctions on the president and senior trial lawyer of the International Criminal Court, further escalating pressure against an institution that it says has unfairly targeted the US and Israel.
item.dc:creator: Sonya Dymova

item.title: Florida’s Primaries Test Political Clout Ahead of Midterms
item.description: How the Sunshine State could set the tone for the November election.
item.dc:creator: Daniel Cancel

item.title: Big Take Asia: North Korea’s New Economic Windfall
item.description: On the Big Take Asia podcast, K. Oanh Ha and Bloomberg’s Cat Barton unpack North Korea’s surprising rise from pandemic-era hardship to a multibillion-dollar windfall, and discuss how the country’s newfound wealth is reshaping geopolitical alliances in Asia. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Trump Takes Hard Line on Iran | Radio Balance of Power: Early Edition 8/18/2026
item.description: On the early edition of Balance of Power, Bloomberg Washington Correspondents Joe Mathieu and Kailey Leinz discuss the latest from the Middle East. On today's show, former National Security Advisor under President Joe Biden Jake Sullivan, Maven Advocacy Co-Founder Partner Jeff Burton, Causeway Strategy Group Principal John McCarthy and Democratic Candidate for Texas Governor Gina Hinojosa. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: UAE Says Iran Fired Two Missiles at Country as War Drags On
item.description: The United Arab Emirates said that two ballistic missiles were fired toward the country from Iran, the Islamic Republic’s first known attack on the Gulf nation since May as the wider Middle East war continues unabated.
item.dc:creator: Sherif Tarek

item.title: France to Expel Two Iranian Diplomats, Foreign Minister Says
item.description: France will expel two Iranian diplomats in the coming days in retaliation for the intimidation of its diplomats in Tehran last month, according to the French foreign minister.
item.dc:creator: Nayla Razzouk

item.title: Trump Only Has Bad Options Left in Iran, Sullivan Says
item.description: Jake Sullivan, former US national security advisor to former President Joe Biden, says at some point President Donald Trump is going to have “to bite the bullet and do a bad deal” with Iran. He speaks on "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: US, Canada Talks Stall as Tariff Deadline Nears With Deal Unlikely
item.description: President Donald Trump’s administration is downplaying expectations for a last-minute deal with Canada to avert fresh tariffs that are set to take effect Wednesday, people familiar with the matter said.
item.dc:creator: Josh Wingrove, Alicia Diaz and Jennifer A. Dlouhy

item.title: Natalie Harp at Center of White House Dispute With Senator Jon Ossoff
item.description: A close aide to Donald Trump is at the center of an ugly clash between the White House and Senator Jon Ossoff, after the Democratic lawmaker drew the administration’s ire for highlighting the close nature of her relationship with the president.
item.dc:creator: Courtney Subramanian

item.title: Trump Making Ballroom ‘Fait Accompli,’ Foes Tell Supreme Court
item.description: President Donald Trump is trying to make his White House ballroom a “fait accompli” by building it so quickly the judiciary won’t be able to stop him, a historic preservation group told the US Supreme Court.
item.dc:creator: Greg Stohr

item.title: Why Iran’s Leaders Need This War to Continue
item.description: Iran has sent Washington a list of demands for reopening the Strait of Hormuz that’s so uncompromising, it seems designed for rejection. Bloomberg Opinion columnist Marc Champion explains why. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Democrats Demand Agencies Stop Sharing Medicaid Data With ICE
item.description: Some top Democratic senators in a Monday letter called on the Department of Health and Human Services and the Department of Homeland Security to stop sharing Medicaid data with US Immigration and Customs Enforcement. item.dc:creator: Macon Atkinson

item.title: Estonia Probes Russia Link in Fire at Defense Manufacturer
item.description: Estonian authorities are investigating potential Russian involvement in a fire that broke out at a building used by defense company Milrem Robotics, according to Prime Minister Kristen Michal.
item.dc:creator: Ott Tammik

item.title: Trump Pick in GOP Florida Governor Race Byron Donalds Must Win Crowded Primary
item.description: Byron Donalds is holding most of the cards as Florida’s Republican voters decide who will be their candidate for the next Governor.
item.dc:creator: Anna J Kaiser and Michael Smith

item.title: Trump Takes Iran Hard Line as Hormuz Tensions Mark New Normal
item.description: US President Donald Trump insisted Tuesday that there were no talks ongoing with Iran, leaving the simmering conflict in the Middle East and control of the Strait of Hormuz stuck in limbo.
item.dc:creator: Jennifer A. Dlouhy and Patrick Sykes

item.title: Putin Praises ‘Especially Trusting’ Ties With Myanmar Leader
item.description: Russian President Vladimir Putin highlighted deepening ties with Myanmar as he met his counterpart Min Aung Hlaing in Moscow during the former junta chief’s first trip to his country’s close ally since taking office in April.
item.dc:creator: Khine Lin Kyaw
